data.one_liner: A Flutter package to create glass effect skeleton loading animations.
data.what_it_does: Adds a glass effect loading skeleton over widgets using a single AnimationController. It uses a custom RenderWidget to achieve the effect.
use_when: You want a glass effect skeleton loading animation in your app
You want to sync multiple skeleton loaders using a single AnimationController
avoid_when: You need complex out-of-the-box shimmering placeholder shapes without custom building them
You do not want to manage an AnimationController manually
strengths: Performs efficiently with a single animation controller over multiple widgets
Uses a custom RenderWidget for the glass effect
weaknesses: Requires manual creation and disposal of an AnimationController
Requires custom container widgets (like FakeCard) to define the skeleton shapes

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a more standard shimmering loading effect rather than a glass effect.
